main.author: Frank Rinder
main.locator: The creation episode in Old-World Japan; local text normalized characters 6915-7386
main.excerpt: Now Izanagi and Izanami wandered on the Floating Bridge of Heaven. This bridge spanned the gulf between heaven and the unformed world; it was upheld in the air, and it stood secure. The God of the Air spoke to the Goddess of the Clouds: "There must needs be a kingdom beneath us, let us visit it." When he had so said, he plunged his jewelled spear into the seething mass below. The drops that fell from the point of the spear congealed and became the island of Onogoro.
main.note: Rinder's modern retelling, not a direct Kojiki translation.

narrativeBlocks.title: The scene
narrativeBlocks.body: Rinder's retelling opens with Izanagi and Izanami above an unformed world. Izanagi stirs the waters with a jeweled spear; drops from its point congeal as the island of Onogoro.

narrativeBlocks.title: The spear stirs the unformed world
narrativeBlocks.body: Source quotation (local English retelling; whitespace normalized): “Now Izanagi and Izanami wandered on the Floating Bridge of Heaven. This bridge spanned the gulf between heaven and the unformed world; it was upheld in the air, and it stood secure. The God of the Air spoke to the Goddess of the Clouds: "There must needs be a kingdom beneath us, let us visit it." When he had so said, he plunged his jewelled spear into the seething mass below. The drops that fell from the point of the spear congealed and became the island of Onogoro.”

narrativeBlocks.title: Why it matters
narrativeBlocks.body: The source gives a literary creation scene, not a direct quotation from an ancient Japanese chronicle. Name Rinder's retelling when describing its details.

narrativeBlocks.title: Read the source boundary
narrativeBlocks.body: This local record is a modern English compilation by Frank Rinder, not a direct Kojiki translation. Use it for the story as retold in this book; seek the Kojiki text for claims about its wording.

narrativeBlocks.title: Carry it forward
narrativeBlocks.body: Track the sequence: divine pair, jeweled spear, drops, island. Do not turn this one retelling into the whole of Japanese creation tradition.
